description: Add an expedition objective readout that gives players a clear next goal while mining, selling, upgrading, and progressing toward the Motherlode.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh, play the current game, and confirm the current HUD/Info state where cargo value and service guidance exist but there is no explicit next-objective or Motherlode progress readout after the intro is dismissed.

Inspect src/ui.tsx, src/dom.ts, src/game.ts, src/economy.ts, src/prospecting.ts, src/balance.ts, src/constants.ts, src/styles.css, and existing tests for current HUD hooks, cargo/upgrade guidance, prospecting rows, depth/fuel/cargo state, and surface service behavior.

Add a DOM-free objective helper that formats concise next-goal copy from player depth, fuel, hull, cargo value/capacity, cash, next cheapest upgrade, and ore/Motherlode milestones; cover states such as fresh start, profitable cargo/return-to-surface, enough cash after sale for an upgrade, low-fuel return warning, and deeper-prospecting goal.

Extend the React HUD and/or Info / Cargo overlay with stable DOM hooks for the objective readout while preserving existing IDs/classes consumed by the runtime; wire src/dom.ts and the HUD update loop to refresh it each frame without duplicating economy logic in the DOM layer.
Style the readout so it is readable on desktop and narrow/mobile layouts and does not overlap the sound status, bars, service guidance, shop buttons, toast, or Info / Cargo overlay content.

Add or update unit tests for the objective helper and React shell markup, including at least one gameplay-like case using starter Coal/Copper cargo and one case where the objective points toward the next ore band or Motherlode progress.

Run ./init.sh and perform a live browser/CDP smoke that starts the game, mines starter ore, observes the objective changing from early mining guidance to return/sell/upgrade guidance, opens Info / Cargo to confirm goal context remains visible, and reports no runtime exceptions.
acceptance: During live gameplay after the intro, the player always has a concise next-objective readout beyond raw cargo value/service status, such as mining the starter seam, returning to sell profitable cargo, buying the next affordable upgrade, or pushing toward the next ore/Motherlode milestone.

The objective copy responds to state changes from mining starter ore and selling/upgrading without breaking the existing cargo value, prospecting guide, surface service guidance, shop enable/disable logic, keyboard shortcuts, sound affordance, intro flow, or mobile HUD readability.
The implementation keeps objective selection logic DOM-free and covered by unit tests, with React/runtime DOM-hook coverage for the rendered readout.
Before marking complete, run ./test.sh plus canonical verification npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build.
